statement: Supplemental complementary remainder bound, literal seededFourthRemainder
final_inequality: |seededFourthRemainder s μ ξ C x ε t| ≤ K*(m*rankΣ*δ²/((t+ε)*sqrt(t+ε)) + m²*sqrt(rankΣ)*δ²/(h0*sqrt(t+ε))), m=s.faces.card, K=12*max(Csingle,max(Csmall,Clarge)).
raw_inputs: bounded independent centered array under its actual probability law
positive ambient dimension and unit marginal variances
actual square covariance factor C, CCᵀ=Cov(sumξ)
ε≥0 and0<t<1; ε>0 for actual time integrability
no_target_premises: no analytic remainder or time-integrability premise
rank_interpretation: The analytic theorem holds for every actual rectangular covariance factor. SupplementalGMinimalFactor.lean constructs a factor with exactly rank(actual covariance) columns by restricting the spectral decomposition to nonzero eigenvalues, and proves rank≥1 from unit marginals plus positive ambient dimension. The final cap_seededFourthRemainder_rank_complementary_bound instantiates this constructor internally; it has no rectangular-factor witness premise and no rank-p substitution.

source_connections.reason: Actual Hessian and fourth derivative single/pair identity; scalar slots, signs, σ powers, and all Fubini exchanges are exact.
Actual angular cancellation and positive pair-weight second derivative, followed by actual whole-point G2 mass. Equal quadratic budgets permit Young’s inequality in place of printed Cauchy–Schwarz.
Signed coefficient matrices are averaged before taking absolute nuclear traces. Exact selector restoration retains Wα. Almost-sure envelopes are clipped only on null sets.

Unconditional retained-base mass and actual Gaussian nuclear moments yield the single and large-angle pair estimates; restoring the Hessian coefficients and Gaussian scales gives the printed facewise rates, and scalar kernels preserve them.

Gaussian nuclear factors, active-face count, parallel/antiparallel zero, and the angle-removing geometric mean give the final complementary scale. The actual three scalar Taylor kernels have uniformly bounded absolute integrals, and σ²=(t+ε)/2 supplies the time powers.

time_integrability_adaptation: The literal R4 is deriv(actual seeded test)+(t/3)*actual cubic law integral on(0,1). General derivative measurability and a proved finite-mask/fixed-product-measure test representation establish time measurability. For ε>0, the actual complementary bound has a constant ε-majorant, yielding genuine IntervalIntegrable R4 and|R4| on0..1.
proof_adaptations: Use Young’s inequality for the same common moment budget in place of the printed Cauchy–Schwarz step.
Work first with any rectangular covariance factor; construct the rank-minimal factor by deleting zero spectral columns and instantiate the actual covariance rank internally.
Use a generic symmetric-matrix restoration abstraction for both H2 and H3.
Use measurable null-set clipping to replace joint AE envelopes only on null sets, preserving all actual integrals.
Establish time measurability from the actual derivative identity plus a finite-mask measurable test representation; actual ε>0 integrability follows from the proved complementary rate.

Arbitrary rectangular-factor whitening proves the aggregate quadratic budget ≤I, which suffices in every angular and signed-restoration estimate; no exact-I covariance identity is assumed for redundant factors. The final rank-minimal covariance factor is instantiated internally.

For the H3 nuclear moment, use trace-dual polarization to bound the cross term by ||u||²+||G||², followed by Young’s inequality and the actual Gaussian coordinate fourth moments. This gives E||H3,u||_*≤5r, in place of the printed sharper cross term 2||G|| and Cauchy–Schwarz; both give the same Cr endpoint.

Use the exact ordered-pair Hessian sum with coefficient1/ℓ² instead of twice the unordered-pair sum. Counting at most m² ordered pairs replaces the printed m²/2 unordered-pair count, and the factor is absorbed in the universal absolute constant.
